prompts.name: head
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE production cutout animation part, an isolated character HEAD, for a Godot 2D side-scrolling game. Native transparent RGBA background.
Subject: original gentle curious anime schoolgirl, long jet-black straight hair character, violet eye, straight bangs, inspired by the delicate charm of Eru Chitanda; polished Arknights battle-chibi linework, opaque cel shading, clean silhouette.
Critical view: EXACT 90-DEGREE RIGHT-FACING PROFILE. The nose points horizontally RIGHT; show exactly ONE violet eye and ONE ear; no far eye, no three-quarter face, no frontal symmetry. True orthographic profile, no perspective. Large rounded chibi cranium, petite face and tiny neutral mouth.
Part boundary: HEAD ONLY, including skull, face, bangs and short hair around the skull ending at the nape plus one slim near-side lock reaching just below chin. Do NOT draw the long rear hair curtain, neck, torso, shoulders, body, hands or any weapon; those are separate assets. Close the silhouette behind the skull with fully painted dark hair. Fully opaque hidden head mass.
Composition: one head centered, occupying 75% of canvas, generous fully transparent padding. Fine dark-violet outline, restrained cool grey-violet highlights on near-black hair, pale skin. No halo, ground shadow, labels, grid, watermark, checkerboard, background or duplicate parts.

The front edge is on RIGHT, the back silhouette is on LEFT. Fill the entire interior with dark hair; no face-shaped hole, neck notch or transparent hole.
